steps: cd /build && tar xf openssl-3.3.1.tar.gz && cd openssl-3.3.1

cd /build && tar xf ffmpeg-4.4.5.tar.xz && cd ffmpeg-4.4.5

collect_deps() {
    aarch64-linux-gnu-readelf -d "$1" 2>/dev/null | grep NEEDED | sed 's/.*\[\(.*\)\]/\1/' | while read -r lib; do
        [ -f "/build/out/libs/$lib" ] && continue
        echo "$lib" | grep -qE "$SKIP_LIBS" && continue
        src=$(find /build/local/lib /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu /lib/aarch64-linux-gnu -maxdepth 1 -name "$lib" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
        if [ -n "$src" ]; then cp -L "$src" "/build/out/libs/$lib"; collect_deps "/build/out/libs/$lib"; else echo "WARNING: $lib not found"; fi
    done
}
for lib in /build/out/libs/*.so*; do collect_deps "$lib"; done
for so in /build/out/libs/*.so*; do aarch64-linux-gnu-strip -s "$so" 2>/dev/null || true; done

pcsx_rearmed-a30.description: PCSX-ReARMed r26-2 standalone: Emu/PS/pcsx_a30 on the Miyoo A30 (portrait panel: PCSX_ROTATE=270). Built as spruceUI/pcsx_rearmed-spruce@d522dc2 build-a30.sh and Dockerfile.a30 do: Linux 5.15.158 headers in the sysroot (CHD), sdl12-compat as SDL 1.2. pcsx embeds two build times a second apart (menu.c, main.c), and sdl12-compat its own
steps: cd /tmp && tar -xf linux-5.15.158.tar.xz && cd linux-5.15.158 && env -u CFLAGS -u LDFLAGS make ARCH=arm CROSS_COMPILE=arm-a30-linux-gnueabihf- headers_install INSTALL_HDR_PATH=/opt/a30/arm-a30-linux-gnueabihf/sysroot/usr && cd / && rm -rf /tmp/linux-5.15.158

cd /opt/a30/arm-a30-linux-gnueabihf/sysroot/usr/lib && ln -sf libSDL2-2.0.so.0.2800.5 libSDL2.so && ln -sf libMali.so libEGL.so && ln -sf libMali.so libGLESv2.so && ln -sf libasound.so.2.0.0 libasound.so

printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'case "$1" in' '    --cflags) echo "-I/opt/a30/arm-a30-linux-gnueabihf/sysroot/usr/include/SDL -D_GNU_SOURCE=1 -D_REENTRANT" ;;' '    --libs)   echo "-L/opt/a30/arm-a30-linux-gnueabihf/sysroot/usr/lib -lSDL" ;;' '    *)        echo "" ;;' 'esac' > /usr/local/bin/sdl-config && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/sdl-config

ppsspp-a30.description: PPSSPP v1.20.3: Emu/PSP/PPSSPPSDL_A30 on the Miyoo A30 (Mali fbdev, GLES2, the portrait panel rotated by a30-1). Built as spruceUI/PPSSPP-spruce@f74caa2 build-a30.sh does: A30 GCC 13.2 with LTO and static libstdc++, plus an fcntl64 shim because the bundled FFmpeg wants glibc 2.28 and the A30 has 2.23
steps: cd /opt/a30/arm-a30-linux-gnueabihf/sysroot/usr/lib && ln -sf libSDL2-2.0.so.0.2800.5 libSDL2.so && ln -sf libMali.so libEGL.so && ln -sf libMali.so libGLESv2.so && ln -sf libasound.so.2.0.0 libasound.so && ln -sf libfreetype.so.6.20.1 libfreetype.so

printf '%s\n' 'set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME Linux)' 'set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR arm)' 'set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER /opt/a30/bin/arm-a30-linux-gnueabihf-gcc)' 'set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER /opt/a30/bin/arm-a30-linux-gnueabihf-g++)' 'set(CMAKE_SYSROOT /opt/a30/arm-a30-linux-gnueabihf/sysroot)' 'set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH /opt/a30/arm-a30-linux-gnueabihf/sysroot)' 'set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PROGRAM NEVER)' 'set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_LIBRARY ONLY)' 'set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_INCLUDE ONLY)' 'set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PACKAGE ONLY)' 'set(PKG_CONFIG_EXECUTABLE /usr/bin/pkg-config)' 'set(ENV{PKG_CONFIG_SYSROOT_DIR} "/opt/a30/arm-a30-linux-gnueabihf/sysroot")' 'set(ENV{PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR} "/opt/a30/arm-a30-linux-gnueabihf/sysroot/usr/lib/pkgconfig")' 'set(CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION TRUE)' > /tmp/a30-toolchain.cmake

printf '%s\n' '#include <stdarg.h>' '#include <fcntl.h>' 'int fcntl64(int fd, int cmd, ...) {' '    va_list ap;' '    va_start(ap, cmd);' '    void *arg = va_arg(ap, void *);' '    va_end(ap);' '    return fcntl(fd, cmd, arg);' '}' > /tmp/fcntl64_compat.c
